_README: Every oskiewar relay. Clients choose among the same hosts (xbox/live/round-room.mjs OSKIEWAR_RELAYS — a test keeps the two lists equal). `monolith` relays ship with session-server/deploy.fish; `relay` boxes ship with deploy-relays.sh; one with "bots": true also runs the fill-bot supervisor (xbox/tools/oskiewar-bot-fill.mjs). Off since 2026-10-17: the public room is humans only (@jeffrey).
